name: Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator
author: Dave

sections.description:
Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator is a WordPress plugin for creating AI-assisted blog content directly from the WordPress dashboard.

The plugin can generate complete blog articles and new blog title ideas using your own OpenAI API key.

The plugin works as a standalone plugin and does not require a separate Dave Gerrits license.

Generate complete blog articles

Enter a blog title, optionally provide additional instructions and select the desired article length.

The plugin then generates a complete article with a clear HTML structure:

  • Exactly one H1 heading
  • Logical H2 headings
  • H3 headings where appropriate
  • Clearly structured paragraphs
  • A readable article structure

The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview and can be copied with one click for use in the WordPress editor.

Always review AI-generated content for accuracy before publishing.

Blog Title Generator

Enter a topic and let the plugin generate 10 blog title ideas.

This feature is intended to provide quick inspiration for new content on your website.

Use your own OpenAI API key

The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key.

In the settings you can configure your API key, preferred AI model and language. A built-in connection test lets you verify that your OpenAI connection is working.

Use of the OpenAI API may result in charges from OpenAI according to the terms and pricing of your own OpenAI account.

Looking for more automation?

Dave Gerrits also offers an extended commercial version called Content AI Agent Pro.

Content AI Agent Pro includes additional features such as:

  • Planning content weeks or months ahead
  • Automatically generating content
  • Automatically publishing articles
  • Generating content ideas
  • Building content clusters
  • Rewriting existing articles
  • Optimizing existing content
  • Generating FAQ content
  • Processing RSS content
  • Advanced queues and automation
  • Analyzing your website for internal linking opportunities
  • Adding smart internal links

More information:
https://davegerrits.nl/content-ai-agent/

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API to generate blog articles and blog title ideas.

When you manually start a generation request, the plugin sends the information required for that request to OpenAI. This may include the blog title, topic, additional instructions, configured language and requested article length.

Data is sent to OpenAI only when you manually start a content generation request or when you use the built-in OpenAI connection test.

The connection to OpenAI uses the API key that you enter in the plugin settings. AI requests are sent directly to OpenAI and are not routed through a Dave Gerrits server.

This external service is provided by OpenAI.

OpenAI Services Agreement:
https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/

OpenAI Service Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/service-terms/

OpenAI Privacy Policy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

By using the OpenAI API, you are responsible for complying with OpenAI’s terms and privacy policy.

Source code and build process

All custom source code required to use and modify this plugin is included directly in the plugin package.

The JavaScript and CSS files in the assets directory are human-readable source files. This plugin does not use npm, webpack or another external build process, and there are no separate compiled or minified distribution files required to build the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through WordPress or upload the dave-gerrits-ai-content-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Dave Gerrits AI Content Generator settings.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key.
  5. Configure the AI model and language if needed.
  6. Save the settings.
  7. Use the connection test to verify the OpenAI connection.
  8. Open the Blog Generator or Blog Title Generator to start creating content.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. The plugin uses your own OpenAI API key to generate content.

Is this plugin free to use?

The WordPress plugin itself does not require a paid Dave Gerrits license. OpenAI may charge for API usage through your own OpenAI account.

Can I generate complete blog articles?

Yes. You can enter a blog title, additional instructions and a desired article length, after which the plugin generates a complete article.

Does the generated article contain headings?

Yes. The output uses one H1 heading, H2 headings and H3 headings where appropriate.

Can I copy the article directly into WordPress?

Yes. The generated article is displayed as a formatted preview and can be copied with the Copy Article button for use in the WordPress editor.

Does this plugin publish articles automatically?

No. This plugin is intended for manual content generation. Automatic planning, generation and publishing are features available in Content AI Agent Pro.

Should I review AI-generated content before publishing?

Yes. Always review factual accuracy, spelling, links and suitability for your audience before publishing AI-generated content.
